about: CameraCalibration facts from Adobe DNG Converter, not profile content. Public sample hashes and URLs refer to raw.pixls.us; those also in tests/corpus/pixls.json must match it. Local sample entries contain only anonymous hashes and numerical facts. NativeWhiteBalance holds the presets read from the original RAW (not its converted DNG) as R, G, B: Sony and Canon Daylight, Canon Shade, Fujifilm's D65 entry, Olympus's 5300 K entry (fine-weather). Non-diagonal and illuminant-dependent calibrations require separate handling. AnalogBalance, written for linear DNGs of in-camera white-balanced modes, is recorded but separate from CameraCalibration.
